deviceSettings.description1: Here are all the devices that are currently logged in with your account. You can log out of each one individually.
deviceSettings.description2: If you see an entry you don’t recognise, log out of that device and change your account password immediately.

server.footer: Auto: Picks a server for you. Pick a server if you always want to stay on it.

streaming.keyDescription: Use these in OBS or another WHIP encoder to go live in a stream channel. Never share them: anyone who has them can stream as you.
streaming.noChannels: No stream channel in this clan
streaming.expiresIn: Start streaming within {{time}}. A stream that is already live keeps going after that.
streaming.expired: This key has expired. Generate a new one to go live.
streaming.error: Could not get a stream key. Please try again.
streaming.obsStepService: In OBS, open Settings → Stream and choose WHIP as the service.
streaming.obsStepPaste: Paste the Server and the Bearer Token from above.
streaming.obsStepEncoder: In Settings → Output, pick an H.264 encoder and set the keyframe interval to 2 s.
streaming.obsStepSimulcast: For several viewing qualities, set simulcast to 3 layers if your OBS version offers it.
streaming.obsStepStart: Click Start Streaming. The key only has to be valid when OBS connects: if OBS reconnects after it has expired, get a new key and paste it again.
streaming.qualityDescription: Used each time you join a stream. You can still change it while watching.

hardwareAcceleration.title: Use graphics acceleration when available
hardwareAcceleration.description: When enabled, the app will leverage your GPU (graphics card) to handle intensive graphics tasks like 3D rendering and video decoding. This improves frame rates and interface responsiveness. If you experience display issues or app crashes, try disabling this feature to improve stability.
